name: Tall Golden Lamp Wide Top
prompt: Create a real editable Blender 3D model of an elegant, tall GOLD floor lamp, not a table lamp. Very long straight slender polished gold brass metal stand with glinting reflections, a round low weighted gold pedestal base, stepped gold collars and ornamental rings around the center of its pole. At the very top is one VERY WIDE large ivory/cream circular drum lampshade, noticeably wider than its base, with thin gold top and bottom rims. Add a warm luminous bulb centered just below the shade and a tiny polished gold finial on the crown. Proportions: lamp roughly 5.5 units tall, shade about 2.7 units in diameter, stand thin and straight. Recognizable floor-lamp silhouette, tasteful realistic materials, tidy symmetric components, standing upright on floor.
